{#- paper-ui's page shell. An app's base template extends it; its pages extend that: {% extends "ui/layout.html" %} {% block head %}{% endblock %} A page sets, before its blocks: {% set nav_current = "reports" %} (the current header nav item: an item's key) {% set browse = True %} (a side column: fill the `side` block) Blocks: title, head (extra tags, after paper-ui's stylesheets), header, side, content, scripts. An app's own header block should keep a place for the settings menu (the reader's colour scheme, settings.js): ui.app_header(..., settings=True). The context comes from paper_ui.flask.init_app: ui_brand, ui_marking, ui_theme, ui_home, ui_nav (a list of {"key", "label", "href"}) and ui_static (the URL of one of paper-ui's static files). -#} {% import "ui/components.html" as ui %} {% block title %}{{ ui_brand }}{% endblock %}{% if ui_marking %} · {{ ui_marking.text }}{% endif %} {% block head %}{% endblock %} Skip to content {%- if ui_marking %}{{ ui.marking_banner(ui_marking, "top") }}{% endif %} {% block header %}{{ ui.app_header(ui_nav, nav_current | default(None), brand=ui_brand, home=ui_home, settings=True) }}{% endblock %}
